text:
Ravi Kulkarni: FYI got a new offer from AuroraEdge for reserved+spot mix. Need to standardize inputs for our cost model and flag any marketplace constraints. Posting their highlights.

Maya Lopez: Paste the schema you want.

Ravi Kulkarni: Use this CSV header for vendors:
```
vendor,sku,gpu_type,reserved_3mo_usd,reserved_6mo_usd,reserved_12mo_usd,spot_p10_usd,spot_p50_usd,spot_p90_usd,blackout_windows,lead_time_days,early_term_fee_pct,min_commit_units,burst_sla_pct,disclosure_allowed,region_capacity_map,volume_ladder
```

Ibrahim Osman: AuroraEdge note: spot_p50 about 30% of reserved, p90 spikes around maintenance windows. They require non-disclosure for some partner SKUs.

Maya Lopez: Finance heads up: we need `marketplace_listing_fee_pct` and `marketplace_revenue_share_tier` added so we can compute effective unit cost.

Ravi Kulkarni: Adding those columns now. Also asking AuroraEdge to provide monthly supply by region (csv with month:units).

VendorOpsBot: Upload queued: task=ingest-5112. Waiting on s3://partners/incoming/aurora/oct-offer.zip

CFO_Desk: If reserved price + marketplace listing pushes effective price above our published SKUs, sales will need approval. Flag `disclosure_allowed=no` rows ASAP.

Ibrahim Osman: Operational ask: include `preempt_profile` tags: NO_NOTICE, 5MIN_NOTICE, 24H_REBALANCE. Makes routing sim deterministic.

Maya Lopez: Also add `commit_cliff_months` and `clawback_credit_pct` so we can model early termination and marketplace credit treatments.

Ravi Kulkarni: Update: vendor returned supply file with monthly capacities and a note: "max eviction 6%/month; emergency 48h maintenance windows in Feb and Sep." They also included a 12mo volume ladder: "1:0;200:-7;1000:-20" for committed discounts.

VendorOpsBot: ingest-5112 started.

VendorOpsBot: ingest-5112 completed: s3://redwood-internal/partners/aurora/offers/aurora-2101234567.csv

Maya Lopez: Great. Next steps: (1) Ops run sensitivity for eviction +50% and +100%; (2) Finance compute effective_unit_usd under low/med/high marketplace fee scenarios; (3) Partnerships confirm disclosure flags so marketing/sales know listing constraints.

Ibrahim Osman: I'll run a quick sim (10k runs) and post percentiles by EOD. Use preempt_profile mapping to determine latency penalties.

Ravi Kulkarni: Thanks. If legal rejects disclosure for any public listing, we'll map those SKUs to private-dedicated offerings only. Will report back after legal review.
